name: Ito HR Partners
description: Ito HR Partners is a business theme for a Dublin consultancy in HR and employment law, working with companies of 15 to 400 people. The sample copy publishes fixed fees for payroll compliance, handbooks and policies, workplace investigations and retainer support, and introduces the seven advisers and three anonymised client stories. Fees are in euro and exclude VAT at 23%. A one-line PT Serif headline with four tick-disc service tags sits over a full-bleed loop of tall rounded photo cards (one cropped to a circle) with a floating slate fixed-fee pill. White approach cards with vertical labels float over a blurred, parallax-moving photograph. PT Serif for headings, PT Sans for reading. Works without WooCommerce. WCAG AA colours; reveals and the loop stop under reduced motion.

fonts.role: display: headings, wordmark, prices in the pill, count numerals (Regular 400 and Bold 700; Latin subset)
text: body, labels, navigation, tags, prices, buttons (Regular 400 and Bold 700; Latin subset)

summary.en: An HR and employment-law consultancy: a one-line headline with tick tags over a looping photo row, a floating fixed-fee pill, indexed service cards and approach cards over a blurred parallax photograph.
